parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json;if(!b.organization_id||!b.external_id)throw new Error('organization_id and external_id required');return [{json:{organization_id:b.organization_id,external_id:String(b.external_id),name:b.name||null,phone:b.phone||null,email:b.email||null,metadata:b.metadata||{}}}];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO contacts(organization_id,external_id,name,phone,email,metadata) VALUES($1::uuid,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6::jsonb) ON CONFLICT(organization_id,external_id) DO UPDATE SET name=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name,contacts.name),phone=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone,contacts.phone),email=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.email,contacts.email),metadata=contacts.metadata||EXCLUDED.metadata,updated_at=now() RETURNING *;
